prior.evidence: Recommended Approach step 3 explicitly defines precision as supported unique findings divided by supported unique findings plus false-alarm unique findings in scored scope, and excludes unresolved and out-of-scope findings while reporting them separately.

Step 1 requires recording unresolved required checks and required report limitations before execution. Step 3 adjudicates narrative coverage and makes an unsupported all-clear, completed-verification claim, or omitted required limitation fail package readiness. Success Criteria also prevents those outcomes from earning wider-use readiness.

Step 4 defines independent verification as locating the cited source and explaining the issue, uncertainty, and next action consistently with adjudication without admin help. Every observed task must meet the rule; an empty exercise is inconclusive, and failures keep the pilot limited pending repair and reassessment. Success Criteria requires a nonempty exercise meeting that rule.
